title: Evaluation of a coordinate decision tree
statement: Let $T$ be a coordinate decision tree with values in $\alpha$, and let $x\in\mathbb{F}_2^n$. Its evaluation at $x$ is the leaf label if $T$ is a leaf; at a query of coordinate $i$, it is the evaluation of the zero-child when $x_i=0$, and otherwise the evaluation of the one-child.
